init.darwin: sh -c 'set -e; case $(uname -s) in Darwin) os=macos;; Linux) os=linux;; *) echo "unsupported OS" >&2; exit 2;; esac; case $(uname -m) in x86_64|amd64) arch=x86_64;; arm64|aarch64) arch=aarch64;; *) echo "unsupported arch" >&2; exit 2;; esac; d="$HOME/.local/waymark"; mkdir -p "$d"; base="https://github.com/QiYueran-source/waymark/releases/download/v0.1.3"; f="waymark-v0.1.3-${os}-${arch}.tar.gz"; tmp="$(mktemp -d)"; curl -fsSL -o "$tmp/$f" "$base/$f"; curl -fsSL -o "$tmp/$f.sha256" "$base/$f.sha256"; (cd "$tmp" && sha256sum --check --quiet "$f.sha256" 2>/dev/null || shasum -a 256 -c "$f.sha256" >/dev/null); tar xzf "$tmp/$f" -C "$tmp"; cp "$tmp/waymark" "$tmp/waymark-mcp" "$d/"; chmod 755 "$d/waymark" "$d/waymark-mcp"; rm -rf "$tmp"; "$d/waymark-mcp" --ready --project "${PWD}" || "$d/waymark-mcp" --ready'
